name: atdd-native-ble
description: ATDD native shell — Capacitor 6 + bluetooth-le for live FIXD (iOS + Android)

scripts.sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build:www && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync:android: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
